title: Dual Destinies
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji tried to organize his thoughts, a familiar chill spread from the depths of his soul—a resonance from his twin of destiny, like a reflection in a mirror slowly awakening.

text.content: The gaze of the Heavenly Eye felt like thorns on his back, and Chen Ji felt his spiritual pressure suddenly increase severalfold. The outline of that fourth possibility was slowly forming in the void, yet he couldn't see what kind of figure it was—as if something was deliberately blurring that foresight. "You've finally arrived." An aged and authoritative voice came from the depths of the void. Chen Ji looked up sharply to see a figure in black and white taiji robes standing in mid-air, surrounded by countless threads of destiny.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji, holder of the Tianji Record, pitiful prophet..." The figure slowly spoke, a hint of inexplicable compassion in the voice. "Do you know why the Tianji Record chose you?" Chen Ji suppressed his unease and said coldly, "Who are you?" The man smiled faintly, the threads of destiny around him trembling: "I am the Heavenly Guardian, commanded to guide every inheritor of the Tianji Record... including your destined twin brother."

text.content: "Twin brother?" Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. Memories surged like a tide—ten years ago during that great sect upheaval, his master Chen Xuan had overlapped his image with that of an infant in his final moments; seven years ago when he first used the Tianji Record, the mirror had reflected a figure identical to himself; three months ago in the Abyssal Void, when the black-clad figure calling himself a "Fate's Outcast" looked at him, his eyes held bone-deep familiarity and venomous hatred... Chen Ji suddenly realized those fragmentary images had never been unrelated.

dialogue.content: "Indeed, you two were originally one entity split into two." The Heavenly Guardian's voice echoed through the void. "When the Tianji Record chose its master, it wavered between you for three full breaths, ultimately choosing you. And he... was judged by fate as the 'negative,' becoming the devourer of all possibilities. You two—one is the original manuscript of the Tianji Record, the other the negative manuscript—the yin and yang sides, indispensable to each other." Chen Ji felt his mind buzzing. He remembered what his master once said: "Heavenly secrets must not be revealed; those who reveal them shall be punished by heaven."

text.content: "So he's been trying to replace me?" Chen Ji's voice was hoarse, yet a glimmer of understanding flashed in his eyes. The Heavenly Guardian shook his head: "No, he is merely trying to become 'complete.' Just as yin and yang need harmony, you two need to merge into one for the Tianji Record to truly become whole." Before the words finished, the void shuddered violently, and the outline of that fourth possibility finally became completely clear—it was not an enemy, but a figure identical to Chen Ji, slowly walking out from the void, a诡异 smile on its face.

dialogue.content: "Brother, it's been a long time." The figure spoke, its voice identical to Chen Ji's. Chen Ji stared at that face exactly like his own, yet his heart was ice-cold—he finally remembered! In Master Chen Xuan's inherited memories, there was a deliberately sealed fragment: when the Tianji Record chose its master, there were indeed two choices—one was the infant Chen Ji, and the other... was another infant sealed by Chen Xuan's own hands. "Are you the one sealed by Master?" Chen Ji asked deeply. Ling Yuan—the figure called itself Ling Yuan—and a mocking arc curled at the corner of its lips: "Sealed? That was imprisonment!"

text.content: The Heavenly Guardian watched this scene quietly, the aged voice carrying a hint of helplessness: "When the Tianji Record selected you both, Chen Xuan, to protect the orthodox inheritance, had no choice but to seal Ling Yuan within the cracks of fate, thinking he would dissipate. Unexpectedly... he instead absorbed all the fate fragments rejected by the Tianji Record, becoming the 'negative manuscript.'" Chen Ji finally understood why his foresight always had blanks at certain crucial moments—it was not a flaw in the Tianji Record, but Ling Yuan's existence interfering!

choice.prompt: Facing this "brother" whose fate had been intertwined with his for over a decade, how should Chen Ji make his choice?

choices.description: Ling Yuan, imprisoned for years, had only hatred and madness in his heart. Even if he shared the same roots, Chen Ji could not entrust his fate to someone who had lost his reason.
choices.visible_cost: Spend 10 Heavenly Fate points to activate the Tianji Record's Complete Foresight
choices.visible_reward: See through all the fatal flaws in Ling Yuan's attack trajectories
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan has merged with fate fragments; his strength is unfathomable

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes flashed with cold light as his hands formed seals, the Tianji Record spinning rapidly in his palm. He wanted to see what right this so-called "negative manuscript" had to compete with him for destiny! In an instant, countless foresight images flooded into his mind—Ling Yuan's attack trajectories, power fluctuations, even emotional changes, all clearly visible. Chen Ji's lips curved into a cold smile: "You think absorbing fate fragments can defeat me? Laughable."

choices.description: Ling Yuan's hatred stems from a childhood of abandonment. If this grudge can be resolved, perhaps the two of them, as the Heavenly Guardian said, could achieve harmony of destiny.
choices.visible_cost: Exposing inner softness, may be exploited by Ling Yuan
choices.visible_reward: Gain knowledge about Ling Yuan's "negative manuscript" abilities
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan has been imprisoned for over a decade; his mentality has become twisted

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and slowly retracted the spiritual energy he had gathered. "Ling Yuan," he stared directly into those eyes identical to his own, "Master's choice hurt you—this I cannot deny. But have you ever considered, if the Tianji Record had chosen you back then, I would be the one cast aside?" Ling Yuan's attack suddenly stopped, a crack appearing in the madness on his face. Chen Ji continued: "We are both pieces on fate's chessboard, why must we destroy each other?"

choices.description: What the Heavenly Guardian called 'yin-yang harmony' may be the true path—letting the original and negative manuscripts merge, allowing the Tianji Record to display its true power.
choices.visible_reward: The complete Tianji Record is unlocked, all Foresight Abilities are doubled
choices.risk_hint: The fusion process is extremely perilous, Chen Ji risks being counteracted by Ling Yuan

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, and the Tianji Record slowly emerged from within him. The golden-glossed fragment rotated in the air, gradually approaching the black fate fragments surging from within Ling Yuan. The Heavenly Guardian cried out: 'Are you mad!' Chen Ji merely smiled faintly: 'The master said Heavenly Secrets cannot be revealed, because he only saw the tragedy of those who revealed them. But what he didn't see is—when yin and yang unite as one, the rules of fate will also be rewritten.' The two rays of light began to converge, a flash of astonishment crossing Ling Yuan's face, then transforming into wild joy.

At the moment when three rays of light were about to collide, the Void violently shattered. A boundless will pressed down from the heavens, freezing Chen Ji, Ling Yuan, and the Heavenly Guardian in place simultaneously. It was... the Heavenly Eye itself! 'Interesting.' An emotionless voice rang in everyone's mind, 'The positive and negative poles of the Tianji Record wish to fuse before me?' Chen Ji felt his qi and blood churning, and he finally understood what the Heavenly Guardian meant by 'the gaze of the Heavenly Eye'—from the very beginning, they had all been part of this chess game.

dialogue.content: 'Great Guardian, is this what you call guidance?' Chen Ji gritted his teeth as he glared at the Heavenly Guardian, 'Lead us here, then let the Heavenly Eye harvest us?' The Heavenly Guardian's form began to blur, and a sigh escaped his lips: 'Chen Ji, this is the tribulation you must endure. Only by completing the fusion under the gaze of the Heavenly Eye can you truly escape the fate of being chess pieces.' Ling Yuan suddenly burst into laughter, the sound carrying a疯狂的快意: 'So that's it! So this was the meaning of my existence—to become the stepping stone for my brother's transformation!'

text.content: A chill ran through Chen Ji's heart as he watched the madness fade from Ling Yuan's eyes, replaced by a resolute calm. 'Brother,' Ling Yuan suddenly spoke, his voice unexpectedly gentle, 'I hated you for over a decade, but now I understand. Rather than hating you, I would become part of you.' Before the words even finished, Ling Yuan's form transformed into a stream of black light, shooting directly toward Chen Ji! Chen Ji instinctively tried to evade, only to find his body completely unresponsive—it was the power of fate, driving this fusion forward!

'No!' Chen Ji roared,拼命调动体内的天命值, attempting to activate the Tianji Record's defenses. However, the Heavenly Eye's will pressed down like a mountain, turning all his resistance into futility. The black light collided into Chen Ji's body, and an ice-cold force instantly swept through him. Chen Ji felt his mind explode with countless scenes flashing by like a carousel—the decade when Ling Yuan was sealed away, years of loneliness, fear, despair, and madness interwoven like a hellish existence...

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan's memories flooded in like a flood—how should Chen Ji respond to this baptism of souls?

choices.description: Thoroughly embrace Ling Yuan's memories and personality, allowing the fusion to reach a perfect state. The cost is that Chen Ji's original self may be diluted.
choices.visible_cost: Personality may be eroded by Ling Yuan's consciousness
choices.visible_reward: Obtain all of Ling Yuan's abilities and memories, achieving 100% fusion
choices.risk_hint: If Ling Yuan's consciousness does not dissipate, he may counteract at a critical moment

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, allowing the ice-cold force to flow freely through his body. He saw everything of Ling Yuan—those dark memories, twisted obsessions, and the hatred born from despair. In the past, Chen Ji would have desperately resisted. But now, he chose acceptance. 'I will remember for you,' he silently said in his heart, 'all that pain, all that hatred... I will remember them all for you.' Ling Yuan's voice echoed in his mind, carrying a hint of释然: 'Thank you, brother.'

choices.description: Selectively accept Ling Yuan's abilities and memories while adhering to one's core personality. This fusion would be imperfect, but can preserve Chen Ji's independence.
choices.visible_cost: Fusion degree only reaches 70%, may not fully control new abilities
choices.visible_reward: Preserve complete personality while obtaining Ling Yuan's core abilities
choices.risk_hint: Incomplete fusion may lead to loss of control over powers

text.content: Chen Ji clenched his teeth, erecting mental defenses the moment that force invaded. He allowed Ling Yuan's memories to flow through, but refused to let them erode his core consciousness. Like flipping through a heavy historical tome, Chen Ji witnessed Ling Yuan's pain while maintaining a旁观者的清醒. 'You may become part of me,' he said in his heart, 'but I remain myself.' After a moment of struggle, Ling Yuan's consciousness finally turned into a wisp of smoke, merging into the depths of Chen Ji's soul.

The moment fusion completed, Chen Ji opened his eyes. He found himself still standing in place, but the spiritual pressure around him had undergone a dramatic transformation. The Tianji Record manifested in his palm, no longer a fragmented yellowed page, but a complete scroll emanating black and white dual-colored light. The Heavenly Eye's will also seemed momentarily startled by this change, and the overwhelming pressure slowly receded. 'Interesting...' that emotionless voice rang out once more, 'The positive and negative halves of the Tianji Record have truly completed their fusion.'

But this is not enough.' The Heavenly Eye's voice carried a hint of amusement, 'Do you think fusion alone can escape the fate of chess pieces? How laughable. We have waited for this moment for tens of thousands of years.' The words fell, and the Void trembled again. Chen Ji looked down at the Tianji Record in his hand, surprised to find a line of never-before-seen text on its pages: 'The Heavenly Eye is a collection of residual wills from generations of fallen seers. It feeds on fate and uses prophets as firewood.' So this was... the truth about the Heavenly Eye!

dialogue.content: 'Young master!' A familiar voice exploded in Chen Ji's mind—it was Mo Xiansheng! Chen Ji suddenly realized that the fusion with the Tianji Record had created some kind of resonance, briefly awakening Mo Xiansheng's residual consciousness. 'Do you see it? This is the true form of the Tianji Record!' Mo Xiansheng's voice carried无法抑制的激动, 'The positive side records possibilities, the negative side devours impossibilities—when the two become one, it is the key to rewriting fate!' Chen Ji tightly gripped the Tianji Record, a surge of unprecedented confidence rising in his heart.

text.content: However, just at this moment, a cold snort echoed from the depths of the Void. A familiar figure stepped out from the rift—it was Ling Yuan—no, it was the Old Sect Master Ling Yuan! In his hand he clutched a pitch-black令牌, its surface bearing the same纹路 as the Heavenly Eye. 'Chen Ji, do you think fusion grants you the freedom to do as you please?' The Old Sect Master狞笑着, 'This old one has waited sixty years for this day! Sixty years ago, Chen Xuan stole the Tianji Record from my hands—today, I will take it back myself!' Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, his voice cold: 'So you are the Heavenly Eye's greatest chess piece in the mortal realm.'

'Chess piece?' The Old Sect Master burst into laughter, the sound filled with madness, 'No, this old one is the messenger of heaven! Sixty years ago, the Heavenly Eye found me and promised that if I helped it gather sufficient fate power, it would make me the new prophet!' He raised the令牌in his hand, black light erupting into the sky, 'And now, I have finally collected enough Heavenly Fate—I'm just short of your final piece!' Chen Ji felt that force locking onto him—it was Heavenly Judgment, powerful enough to annihilate everything. He had to make a choice.

choice.prompt: Facing the joint suppression of the old Sect Master and the Heavenly Eye, how will Chen Ji break this deadlock?

choices.description: Using the complete power of the newly fused Tianji Record to directly confront Heavenly Judgment, even if it means destruction, to tear off the old Sect Master's disguise.
choices.visible_reward: Reveal to everyone present the truth of the old Sect Master's collusion with the Heavenly Eye
choices.risk_hint: When Heavenly Fate reaches zero, it will trigger fate's backlash

text.content: Chen Ji forcefully activated all the power within his body, and the Tianji Record erupted with unprecedented light in his palm. 'Old thing, do you think the Heavenly Eye will help you?' He coldly smiled as he opened the complete Tianji Record. 'It never needed chess pieces, it only needs fuel!' The pages rapidly turned, countless scenes flickering past like a lantern parade—those were the visions of seers from past generations being devoured by the Heavenly Eye, and the old Sect Master was precisely the executioner who sacrificed them!

choices.description: Exploit the conflicting interests between the Heavenly Eye and the old Sect Master, provoke them to turn against each other, and reap the benefits from their mutual destruction.
choices.visible_cost: Requires precise manipulation of both parties' emotions
choices.visible_reward: Turn the Heavenly Eye against the old Sect Master
choices.risk_hint: If exposed, it will offend both sides simultaneously

text.content: A cold smile curled on Chen Ji's lips as he suddenly spoke: 'Old Sect Master, do you know where the Heavenly Eye's collected Heavenly Fate goes?' The old Sect Master hesitated, and Chen Ji continued: 'It never intended to make you a seer—it merely needs sufficient Heavenly Fate to repair its origin damaged in the ancient war. And you are nothing more than another fuel about to be devoured.' As the words fell, the old Sect Master's face changed drastically, and the token in his hand began devouring his Heavenly Fate on its own!

choices.description: Preserve strength and seek a more opportune moment. The alliance between the old Sect Master and the Heavenly Eye must have fractures—only need to wait for the right time.
choices.visible_cost: Abandon the chance to expose the truth
choices.visible_reward: Preserve strength and gather power for future counterattack
choices.risk_hint: The old Sect Master may pursue and attack

text.content: Chen Ji made a decision that surprised everyone—he simply turned and left. The Tianji Record unfurled behind him, transforming into a black-and-white intertwined curtain of light that directly tore apart the void. 'Chen Ji! You cannot escape!' The old Sect Master roared as he gave chase, but Chen Ji had already vanished into the rift. Mr. Mo's voice rang in his mind, carrying approval: 'Good judgment, Young Master. Though the Tianji Record is now complete, you have not yet fully mastered its power. Reckless confrontation would only let the Heavenly Eye profit from others' mistakes.'

Chen Ji passed through the void and crashed heavily onto an unfamiliar ruins. He struggled to sit up, sensing the power fluctuations from the Tianji Record within his body—a brand new state after the fusion of positive and negative poles, both familiar and foreign. He raised his hand, gazing at the scroll of Tianji Record glowing softly in his palm, his heart filled with mixed emotions. Ling Yuan's consciousness and memories had merged with his own, those dark past events, twisted resentment—all now became part of him.

Just as Chen Ji tried to sort through his thoughts, a familiar chill spread from the depths of his soul. That was the resonance from the twin of destiny—no, it was from Ling Yuan's remaining consciousness fragments. 'Brother,' the voice rang in his mind, carrying a strange smile, 'Don't think that fusion means everything will be fine. I never said I would give you all my power...' Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, an unprecedented sense of crisis surging through his heart. The chess game of destiny is far from over.

Above the ruins, the sky suddenly changed. A brilliant starlight tore through the night sky as Su Qingyao's figure descended like a fairy. She held a sword in hand, her brow filled with anxiety: 'Chen Ji! I sensed the anomaly of the Tianji Record, are you alright?' Following closely, Ye Qing also stepped out from the void, demonic path mist swirling around her, her gaze toward Chen Ji carrying a hint of inquiry. And from the distant horizon, a berserk aura was rapidly approaching—that was Han Lie, the number one genius of the Xuanwu Sect! Three powers converged upon these ruins in the blink of an eye.

However, the Chen Ji of this moment had no time to attend to them. His consciousness was engaged in a silent struggle with Ling Yuan's residual will—the page belonging to Ling Yuan in the Tianji Record was emanating a strange black light, as if brewing something. 'Brother, do you think fusion is the end?' Ling Yuan's voice echoed in his mind, 'Wrong, fusion is merely the beginning. When my consciousness fully awakens, who exactly will be the master of this body... may no longer be certain.' Chen Ji gritted his teeth, cold sweat beading on his forehead. This battle concerning destiny had just begun.
